verdict.rationale: Airwallex documents its own payouts capability for paying suppliers: Transfers moves funds to suppliers (docs-6), Batch Transfers handles bulk supplier payments (docs-7, docs-19), and the Bills API manages vendor invoices (docs-5). However, no evidence names domestic ACH or wire as payout rails, and the local-payment-method evidence covers receiving funds only. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of domestic ACH payouts, explicit documentation of domestic wire (e.g., Fedwire) payouts, and independent or hands-on corroboration of US domestic vendor payments.
